Name: Monster Beverage Corp
Description: Monster Beverage Corporation is a leading player in the energy drink market, renowned for its flagship Monster Energy brand as well as its diverse product portfolio, which includes beverages such as Relentless and Burn. Founded in 1985 and headquartered in Corona, California, the company has successfully expanded its reach both domestically and internationally, appealing to a broad consumer base with innovative flavors and marketing strategies. With a strong focus on brand development and strategic partnerships, Monster continues to capitalize on the growing demand for functional beverages, positioning itself as a formidable competitor in the fast-evolving beverage industry.
Address: 1 MONSTER WAY, CORONA, CA, UNITED STATES, 92879
